meta.title: Southeast Acquisition Capital — Long-term investors in employee ownership
meta.description: Southeast Acquisition Capital sponsors Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOPs), helping founders and family owners exit while every employee becomes an owner. Businesses with $5-50M revenue across the Southeast and Midwest.

lede: Southeast Acquisition Capital is a financial sponsor of Employee Stock Ownership Plans. We help founders and family owners achieve a successful exit, build upon their legacy, and reward the people who helped them succeed.

thesis.text: When a business owner sells to a Southeast-sponsored ESOP, the company remains independent for the long term and will not be flipped to another investor. Employees own 100% of the common equity.

steps.title: The owner sells, at market terms.
steps.text: Southeast sponsors a leveraged ESOP buyout, competitive with financial and strategic acquirers on valuation, structure, timeline, succession planning and cash proceeds at close.

steps.title: Mission-aligned capital partners.
steps.text: We bring together capital providers who appreciate long-term holds. At A-R-T & Associates, the Allivate Employee Ownership Fund provided the financing to complete the ESOP transition.

steps.title: An operator to lead the business.
steps.text: We recruit experienced business leaders, so the owner's departure has a successor. At A-R-T & Associates, Geoffrey Easterling was appointed CEO.

steps.title: Every employee becomes an owner.
steps.text: 100% of the common stock is held by the ESOP for all eligible employees. We underwrite to deliver one year's salary to every day-one employee within 5 to 10 years.

focusIntro: We acquire profitable businesses throughout the Southeast and Midwest, and incorporate employee ownership into every investment.

criteria.v: $5-50M revenue and $1-10M EBITDA; average EBITDA per employee above $50k.
Recurring revenue, a stable customer base, low-to-moderate capital intensity, and a platform for future acquisitions.
Full management succession, staged succession, or internal promotion.
100% of the common stock held by an ESOP for the benefit of all eligible employees.

sectorsText: We recruit experienced business leaders to build employee-owned holding companies in these industries.
pillars: We partner with experienced leaders to build industry-focused platforms into employee-owned holding companies, with investors who appreciate long-term holds.
Broad-based equity gives all employees access to ownership. We underwrite to an average employee equity value of $50-100k over the first ten years.
Employees engage with every part of the business and understand how their role drives value, with transparency and accountability throughout.
First more value for existing customers and productivity through better technology; then acquisitions in complementary markets, with a sustainable financial structure.
portfolioIntro: In December 2025, A-R-T & Associates became 100% employee-owned, with Southeast as sponsor of the transaction.

portfolio.name: A-R-T & Associates
portfolio.desc: A national, full-service experiential design firm in environmental graphics, interior signage and custom art installations. Southeast led the ESOP formation, financed by Allivate Impact Capital, preserving the firm's legacy and its 20+ jobs.

teamIntro: We look to partner with people who share our values of accountability, transparency and true partnership, and who genuinely enjoy their work.

team.name: Jim Ward
team.title: Co-Founder
team.sum: Fifteen years as a private equity investor, financial manager, investment banker and advisor to middle-market companies in the Southeast.
bio: Jim has fifteen years of experience as a private equity investor, financial manager, investment banker, and advisor to middle-market companies throughout the Southeast.

He was a member of 2nd Generation Capital, where he advised small enterprises on financial strategy, helped clients raise debt and equity capital, and developed relationships with private equity, mezzanine and debt capital providers throughout the country. He also held financial management positions with Mars and Fannie Mae, and has been involved with the Nashville Chapter of the Exit Planning Institute, which provides business owners with resources and education around their business transition.
Jim graduated cum laude from Princeton University and earned an MBA from the Owen Graduate School of Management, where he was Beta Gamma Sigma with concentrations in Finance, Accounting and Strategy.

team.name: Michael Morosi
team.title: Co-Founder and Managing Partner
team.sum: More than a decade investing in public and private companies globally, across all sectors of the economy.
bio: Michael has over a decade of experience as an investor in public and private companies globally and across all sectors of the economy.

Before founding Southeast Acquisition Capital, he was an equity portfolio manager at MAPFRE Asset Management in Madrid, where he co-managed $100M in equity funds, including the MAPFRE AM Good Governance Fund, a global ESG fund.

Earlier, Michael founded Atlantica Capital Consulting, a capital markets advisory firm; was an equity analyst for Jetstream Capital, a global equity hedge fund in Brentwood, Tennessee, and helped launch Jetstream Ventures, a family office impact fund; and was an analyst at Stephens Inc. and Avondale Partners.

He graduated magna cum laude with a BA in Economics and Business from Kalamazoo College and received an Executive MBA at IE Business School in Madrid, where he later served as an Adjunct Professor of Finance.

team.name: Michael Brady
team.title: Operating Partner, Food & Beverage
team.sum: Former President and CEO of Greyston Bakery; co-founder of the Organic Food Incubator.
bio: Michael has more than twenty years of experience in strategy and management, identifying business opportunities in high-growth and transitional industries.

He spent eight years as President and CEO of Greyston Bakery in Yonkers, New York, one of the country's foremost social enterprises, achieving record growth by overhauling operations at its 23,000 sq. ft. commercial bakery. His TED Talk, "Why We Hire Unemployable People", set out the vision behind Greyston Foundation's Center for Open Hiring.

He co-founded the Organic Food Incubator in Bloomfield, New Jersey, the first business incubator in the country dedicated to organic food production and distribution. Earlier he was a strategy consultant with PwC and Vice President of Global Mobile & Media Solutions at FAST Search and Transfer.
Michael holds an MBA from the Wharton School and a BS in Finance, cum laude, from the University of Delaware.

team.name: Geoff Easterling
team.title: CEO, A-R-T & Associates
team.sum: CEO of A-R-T & Associates since its transition to 100% employee ownership.
bio: Geoffrey Easterling was appointed CEO of A-R-T & Associates to oversee the company's long-term value creation strategy after its transition to 100% employee ownership.

He is a West Point graduate, Army combat veteran, and UC Berkeley Haas School of Business MBA class president. As Chief of Staff at Centennial Yards, a $5 billion, 50-acre development in downtown Atlanta, he led accounting, infrastructure and community initiatives. Before that he worked at McKinsey & Company and served in the U.S. Army.

cta.title: Plan an exit that rewards your people.
cta.text: We'd love to hear from business owners looking for a long-term partner, executives interested in joining as operating partners, and intermediaries. We pay standard buy-side fees for referred opportunities that close, subject to a fee agreement.

contact.title: Let's talk.
contact.intro: Southeast Acquisition Capital provides business owners both a market for their business and an operator to manage it after the owner's departure.
contact.note: We pay standard buy-side fees for investment opportunities that close, subject to a fee agreement.
